Ayodhya to host 2100-drone light show depicting Ramayana scenes

Ayodhya's Sarayu riverfront will be illuminated by a 2100-drone light show during the Deepotsav festival, depicting scenes from the Ramayana, including the battle between Ram and Ravan. A fire show will also be conducted from the old Sarayu bridge.
